definition: to be your decision to make
description: In a bright old-fashioned ice-cream parlour with painted tiles and a glass chandelier, a young woman in a cream knitted jumper and a green skirt leans over a long glass counter full of trays of ice cream, including pistachio, fig, blood orange, lemon and chocolate, touching her cheek and pointing as she tries to choose. A young man in a brown shirt stands beside her, watches her and laughs. Behind the counter a young woman in a white shirt and navy apron waits and works.

en.question: What is the female customer doing?

de.answer: Sie beugt sich über die Eistheke.
de.question: Was macht die Kundin?

es.answer: Se está inclinando sobre el mostrador de helados.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la clienta?

fr.answer: Elle se penche au-dessus du comptoir des glaces.
